licence.scope: Level 2, ESO archive data access policy, following the sibling Paranal/FORS1 record. It covers data in the ESO archive; the curves are on the eso.org/sci instrument page https://www.eso.org/sci/facilities/paranal/decommissioned/vimos.html (footer '© ESO'), which names no statement, so class is kept 'unknown' as for FORS1 (change to attribution if judged to apply by analogy). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Publications based on data obtained with the VIMOS instrument should quote the following reference paper: Le Fevre, O. et al. 2003, SPIE 4841, 1670
